name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-02-09, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
